server_url.label: Server URL
server_url.description: Full URL of the LX Music server, e.g. http://localhost:9527

password.label: Password
password.description: Login password for the lxserver account (required); can be reset in the lxserver admin panel.

default_source.label: Default source
default_source.description: Source preferred when resolving stream URLs (kw/kg/tx/wy/mg)

search_sources.label: Search sources
search_sources.description: Comma-separated list of sources polled during search

import_leaderboards.label: Show leaderboards in browse
import_leaderboards.description: Shows a leaderboards entry (~50 charts) in the browse view.

import_square_playlists.label: Show square playlists in browse
import_square_playlists.description: Shows a square playlists entry (top 5 per category) in the browse view.

radio_refresh_minutes.label: LX Radio refresh interval (minutes)
radio_refresh_minutes.description: How many minutes LX Radio keeps one batch of songs. Within the same interval every open returns the same batch; it only changes across intervals. Default {0} (hourly); allowed {1}-{2}.

daily_source.label: Daily picks source
daily_source.description: Which platform's official charts the daily picks mix songs from; a new batch every day. Default Kuwo, applies immediately.

newsong_source.label: New song picks source
newsong_source.description: Which platform's new-song charts the new-song picks mix songs from. Default Kuwo, applies immediately.

sync_love_list.label: Sync LX hearted favorites
sync_love_list.description: Two-way favorites sync between the LX app / lxserver and MA library favorites; hearting in MA writes back to lxserver immediately. When off, existing library items stay.

user.title: Connect to LX Music server
user.description: Enter the address and login of your self-hosted lxserver (https://github.com/xcq0607/lxserver).

radio.name: LX Radio
radio.subtitle: Randomly samples multiple charts, switches to a new batch every {0} minutes

daily_kw.name: Daily Picks
daily_kw.subtitle: Mixed from Kuwo official charts, refreshed daily

daily_kg.name: Daily Picks
daily_kg.subtitle: Mixed from Kugou official charts, refreshed daily

daily_tx.name: Daily Picks
daily_tx.subtitle: Mixed from QQ Music official charts, refreshed daily

daily_wy.name: Daily Picks
daily_wy.subtitle: Mixed from NetEase Cloud Music official charts, refreshed daily

daily_mg.name: Daily Picks
daily_mg.subtitle: Mixed from Migu Music official charts, refreshed daily

new_tx.name: New Song Picks
new_tx.subtitle: Mixed from QQ Music new-song charts

new_wy.name: New Song Picks
new_wy.subtitle: Mixed from NetEase Cloud Music new-song charts

new_mg.name: New Song Picks
new_mg.subtitle: Mixed from Migu Music new-song charts

radio.name: LX Radio
radio.description: Randomly samples multiple charts, switches to a new batch every {0} minutes

errors.empty_username: Username is empty. Set the lxserver username in the provider settings.
errors.empty_password: Password is empty. Set the lxserver password in the provider settings (reset it in the lxserver admin panel if forgotten).
errors.login_no_token: Login failed: the server returned no token. Check the username and password.
errors.love_sync_disabled: LX heart sync is turned off; this sync round was skipped.
errors.love_list_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch the hearted playlist; this sync round was skipped.
errors.user_playlists_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch user playlists; this sync round was skipped.
errors.track_info_not_found: Track info not found on lxserver or in Music Assistant; cannot heart it (it may have been delisted).

manifest.description: Stream music from a self-hosted LX Music server (lxserver): cross-source search, lyrics, leaderboards, playlists, daily picks and radio.
